entries.name: Superset
entries.agent_os_overlap: Worktree-per-task and multi-CLI support already exist in the orchestrator; Superset adds a human-facing GUI.

ideas: scope CLI lifecycle hooks to project config or an env-var guard, never global user config (HOOKS_INVESTIGATION.md)

evidence.quality: no benchmark; vendor comparison pages only
evidence.reliability: own investigation doc shows hooks firing outside the app
evidence.security: writes hooks into global agent configs
evidence.portability: macOS primary, Linux experimental, no Windows

entries.rationale: Human-facing IDE under a source-available (ELv2) license; isolation is plain git worktree, which we already use. Only lesson is hook-scoping hygiene.
provenance: web search: vendor and roundup pages; no r/OpenSourceAI thread found
revisit_when: Agent OS installs CLI hooks that touch user-level config

entries.name: Orca
entries.agent_os_overlap: Worktree-per-worker and coordinator/worker states exist; Orca's removal guards are a checklist for our cleanup.

evidence.quality: no benchmark; best-of-N selection left to the human
evidence.reliability: extensive worktree failure handling and tests in the repo
evidence.security: agent trust presets and credential file protection present, not audited

entries.rationale: Borrow only the worktree-removal guard conditions as unit fixtures for our cleanup. The GUI is out of scope and best-of-N is not justified by our retry-cost data.
provenance: web search: vendor and review pages; orchestration skill is a stub, protocol served by the binary
revisit_when: validators can act as a cheap best-of-N selector

entries.name: Scion
entries.agent_os_overlap: Worktree isolation exists; container and credential isolation per worker does not.

evidence.development_savings: none until container workers are needed
evidence.runtime_savings: none measured; perf/bench covers platform API and start-up only
evidence.reliability: auth fail-fast and failure memo show care; experimental status
evidence.security: per-agent container and credential isolation is the main strength

entries.rationale: Container isolation matters only for untrusted or multi-tenant workers; the cheap failure-memo idea needs a replay count of repeated identical launch failures first.
provenance: web search: InfoQ, DevOps.com coverage repeating the README
revisit_when: workers run untrusted code or need separate credentials
replay shows repeated identical launch failures

entries.name: deepagents
entries.agent_os_overlap: Sub-agents are our worktree workers; context management happens inside the CLI, not in Agent OS. Overlaps PA-langgraph and PA-smolagents.

ideas: offload tool results over 20k tokens to a file and return head plus path (filesystem.py)

evidence.development_savings: negative if adopted as a harness (rewrite of CLI workers)
evidence.runtime_savings: unverified; defaults 85% trigger, keep 10%, no ablation in repo
evidence.quality: vendor-run evals in libs/evals, not independently verified
evidence.security: permissions middleware and sandbox backends exist

entries.rationale: Harness duplicates what the CLIs do; our measurements (cache rewrite cost, lossy loss rate, 94% already-narrow output) argue against its heuristics. The lossless large-result offload needs a replay count before any work.
provenance: web search found no independent evaluation
revisit_when: Agent OS gains its own agent loop via adapters/http_api.py
replay shows results over 20k tokens carry material input cost

entries.name: Pi coding agent
entries.agent_os_overlap: Could be a third CLI adapter beside Claude Code and Codex; its cache-warmer is a cost-model reference.

evidence.runtime_savings: possible via cheaper model tiers; unproven
evidence.quality: no external benchmark reviewed; packages/evals not run
evidence.security: project trust manager present; not audited
evidence.maintenance: very active; repo location may have moved

entries.rationale: Print/JSON/RPC modes make an adapter feasible and could add a cheaper escalation tier, but that is unproven and the canonical repo (badlogic/pi-mono vs earendil-works/pi) must be confirmed.
provenance: web search found no independent evaluation
revisit_when: a lower-cost model tier is wanted in the escalation ladder
